info.name: Aligaga Shop API
info.description:
All REST methods of the shop API plus JWT authentication and authorization tests.

Run it: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed, php artisan serve, then open the collection and choose Run (Collection Runner). Run the folders in order: 00 Auth logs in and saves the tokens that the later requests use.

Accounts from the seeder (password: password): admin@example.com (admin), test@example.com (user). A1 registers a fresh user every run.

Tokens: GET requests are sent without a token (guest). Category changes use {{adminToken}}, item and review changes use {{userToken}}.
The base URL is the collection variable baseUrl (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api).

exec: // Runs after every request: every answer except 204 must be JSON.

exec: pm.test('the new user is an ordinary user, the sent role=admin is ignored', () => pm.expect(json.user.role).to.eql('user'));
pm.test('returns an access token and a refresh token', () => {
pm.test('the access token holds the user ID and role', () => {

exec: pm.test('returns a new access token and a new refresh token', () => {
